title: Five Cops Take On 40 Gangsters With Only A Chicken Van . . . (Extreme Job)
caption:
Extreme Job (2019): a failing narcotics squad buys a fried chicken shop to spy on a drug gang across the street... and the chicken becomes a hit 🍗 Follow for more movie recaps!

#extremejob #kmovie #movierecap #spoilerroom #fyp
comment: Was Ray right to risk his whole squad on one chicken shop? Why?

segments.say: Five cops walk into forty gangsters at a shipping port, and their only backup is a *chicken* van.
To see how it got here, go back to the day a *drug bust* turned into a car wreck.
Captain Ray runs a narcotics squad, and his team hangs off a roof to catch one *dealer* through a window.
But the dealer jumps out, grabs a *white car*, and the chase is on.
They sprint after him, and a scooter flattens Anna in the middle of the *street*.
The thief crashes his stolen car, and *sixteen* cars pile up behind him.
Ray just stands there, and the whole crash goes *viral*.
Chief Brown calls the squad in, and he is *furious*.
Meanwhile their rival Dan just got *promoted* for a huge drug bust.
Ray had officially hit *rock bottom*.
Then Dan shows up in the hallway to *rub it in*.
He says a transit bus caught Ray's perp, and the whole station *laughs*.
But over dinner, Dan hands Ray a *last chance*. The drug lord Vince is back in Korea.
Vince's right hand man, Hank, got out six months ago, and now he is putting together a *gang*.
Ray hates it, but this is his only way *back*.
So the squad parks outside Hank's hideout and *waits*.
Then a woman spots them and calls the *police* on the whole squad.
Their cover is almost blown, and Ray knows they need a better *spot*.
Right across the street, there is a sad, empty *chicken joint*.
The squad orders chicken just to sit and watch, and they *complain* the whole time.
Then Hank's men pull up outside, and the squad hits the *floor*.
Ray says no warrant, no problem, he takes full *responsibility*.
So he asks the owner if she *delivers* to the building across the street.

segments.text: You're the only customers I've had all week.

segments.say: Then Ray comes up with a crazy idea. Buy the shop and *run it* as their cover.
His squad thinks he lost it, but nobody has a better *plan*.
So they buy the shop and pose as two brothers and two married *couples*.
In the back room, they set up screens to spy on Hank's whole *building*.
This is either genius or *insane*.
On the monitors, Hank's gang picks fighters for a basement *fight club*.
The first real customers walk in, and the squad has no idea how to *cook*.
So they fry a first batch from scratch, and everyone is shocked when it's actually *good*.
Word spreads fast, and the shop is suddenly *packed*.
Anna is wiping tables, taking orders, and *losing her mind*.
The whole squad starts fighting about who works *harder*.
Meanwhile, Hank tells Vince to cut out the middleman, Ted Chang, and sell *directly*.
Then Chief Brown storms in and says the narcotics squad will be *restructured*.
So they send chicken to the hideout and plant bugs in the office and *hallway*.
Then the news calls their shop a *sensation*.
A man in a suit puts a briefcase of cash on the *table*.
Soon there is a grand opening, with balloons, sashes, and the whole squad *cheering*.
Then Ted Chang shows up, a smooth man in a cream suit and yellow *glasses*.
His chicken chain has a delivery guy who runs the exact same *route* every day.
Then Ben cracks it. The gang is moving drugs inside chicken *deliveries*.
Anna and Max dress up as internet repair workers to get inside the gang's *apartment*.
Then a bug picks up their plan. Hand the company to Ted Chang and kill *Jim*.
And the trap is simple. Lure the cops in and kill them *there*.
Ray hears it and says they can't let them get *away*.
But then Tony vanishes, and all they have is his *phone*.
The squad tracks it to a warehouse, and it turns into a *brawl*.
A line of vans rolls into a shipping port, just like the gang *planned*.
Vince and Ted Chang face off in the dark with their armies behind *them*.
One wrong word, and the port turns into a *war zone*.
The squad hides behind the containers and lets the gangs kill *each other*.
Then headlights cut through the smoke, and it's not the police. It's a *chicken van*.
The squad steps out and tells forty gangsters they are all under *arrest*.
Then the biggest brawl of the movie *begins*.
Max used to be navy special forces, and you can *tell*.
Anna is a Muay Thai champion, and she flattens every thug who touches *her*.
Then the fight spills onto the *pier*, one on one.
Ray corners the last boss, and he spits blood and asks what Ray even *is*.
Then one last *punch* ends it.
By the time the sirens come, the whole gang is *down*.
Bloody and bruised, they get loaded into ambulances, and Ray's squad just broke the biggest drug ring in the *country*.
Weeks later, at an appointment ceremony, the squad stands tall in uniform and gets *promoted*.
Five cops, one chicken shop, and the bust of their lives. Wonder what we *spoil* next?
